title: The Liquidation Value Split
description: A liquidation mints a fixed prize — the bonus on seized collateral. Three bars split it three ways: a gas war bleeds it to the block builder, private orderflow pockets it for the searcher, an OEV auction returns ~73% to the protocol. Drive size, bonus, competition; anchored to Chainlink SVR figures.
